explanation: Calculates the percentage of total fair value represented by debt (is_debt = 1) versus non-debt (is_debt = 0) across all holdings in holdings_v.
sql: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN is_debt = 1 THEN fair_value ELSE 0.0 END) * 100.0 / SUM(fair_value) AS debt_fair_value_percentage, SUM(CASE WHEN is_debt = 0 THEN fair_value ELSE 0.0 END) * 100.0 / SUM(fair_value) AS non_debt_fair_value_percentage FROM holdings_v
